item.text: The current hasher stores opaque `maphash.Seed` values per ID, so it can generate new seeds but cannot restore one from a string. I’ll store the caller’s seed string per ID and use one `maphash.Seed` on each `Hasher` to hash the seed and input together.

The API and regression cases are in place. I also added locking around the seed map, since the package-level hash function is shared by database connections. I’ll format the files and run the hasher tests now.

item.text:
Implemented `SetSeed` on both the package and `Hasher`. Hashes now stay consistent for a given ID and seed, change after reseeding, and return to their original value when that seed is restored. Missing seeds initialize automatically, and seed map access is synchronized.

Tests passed for `./utils/hasher`, `./db`, and `./persistence`, plus the hasher race test. Numeric hashes are stable within a process; the process-wide `maphash` seed changes on restart.
